Messages.Author: Hyllan
Messages.Body:
Can Vidal Jarbeaux play Grooming the Protégé to move blood to a younger non-Toreador vampire?

Vidal Jarbeaux
Camarilla: Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g., Black Hand) requirement to play any card. He can meet a given requirement only once each game. +1 bleed.

Grooming the Protégé
Master.
Move up to 3 blood from a ready vampire you control to a younger vampire of the same clan in your uncontrolled region.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Grooming the Protégé doesn't require a clan, so Vidal cannot try to pretend he's from another clan.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
